; Modern Camera Collision -- object overrides.
;
; Any *.ini in this folder is read at load and when the MCM closes; a mod can
; ship its own file here. An override gives one object a rule that wins over
; its collision layer's -- even the ground's. Files are read in name order and
; a later file's rule for the same object wins, so a patch can override a mod.
;
; Rename this file to end in .ini to use it.
;
; A section names the object, one of:
;   [Plugin.esp|0xFORMID]          the base object's form, plugin name and its
;                                  form id within that plugin (the load-order
;                                  byte is ignored)
;   [model:path\to\model.nif]     every base object with that model, the path
;                                  as the record has it, case does not matter
; with one key:
;   rule = measure | stop | through | fade
;     measure: the bumper and the size decide, as for any object
;     stop:    always stops the camera
;     through: never stops it
;     fade:    never stops it; faded whole, whatever its size

;[Skyrim.esm|0x29CB0]
;rule = stop

;[model:Architecture\Farmhouse\Interior\FarmInt2Doorway03.nif]
;rule = stop
